tool.help:
**OpenMS FILEFILTER**
Filter and preprocess MS data files
OpenMS is a comprehensive open-source framework for LC-MS data analysis, providing modular tools for complete proteomics and metabolomics workflows.
**Citation:** Röst HL, Sachsenberg T, Aiche S, et al. OpenMS: a flexible open-source software platform for mass spectrometry data analysis. Nat Methods. 2016 Sep;13(9):741-8. doi: 10.1038/nmeth.3959
